_comment: Serious and critical WCAG 2.1 A/AA violations the application currently has, per page, as { ruleId: nodeCount }. A new rule or a higher count fails the build. A lower count fails too — lower the number here when something is fixed, so the improvement is locked in and cannot regress back silently. Written up in docs/DEFECT-LOG.md as TOOL-2105 and TOOL-2106.
